note: Oudenaarde: second wall of before 1279 on both banks of the Scheldt (taking in Pamele), with the Burgundian castle of 1385; rebuilt by Vauban only in 1667-78, so the 1650 line is the older (partly bastioned) one. Traced from the Ferraris map (1777) along the main rampart, which is Vauban's line: approximate.
source: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Oudenaarde' (https://id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140026)
